review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Duties and Responsibilities: Participate in team projects, meetings, and assignments to support infrastructure initiatives. Support the configuration and administration of virtual servers in VMware and/or Hyper-V environments. Assist with patching and system updates to reduce vulnerabilities and maintain system health. Maintain and verify backup systems; participate in disaster recovery testing and documentation. Help configure and maintain core services such as DNS, DHCP, DFS, and Certificates.

review_candidates.title: VCF Network Engineer I
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Support administration of SDDC Manager, workload domains, and vSphere cluster operations. Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and support knowledge articles. Preferred Qualifications VMware certification such as VCP-VCF or VCP-DCV. Required Qualifications A minimum of 3 years of experience in infrastructure operations, virtualization, or systems administration. Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere administration. Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server administration.
eligibility_evidence: This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future, including F-1, OPT, CPT, H-1B, or other employment-based visa sponsorship.
Schedule & Presence: This on-site role supports 24/7 operations through real-time collaboration, standard shifts occur within a 6:00 AM - 6:00 PM window, Monday through Friday.
Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.
